body: The condition stress midpoint in `update_molt_stress()` (shrimp.rs:490) is hardcoded as `0.5`: `let condition_stress = (0.5 - state.animal.population_condition_index()).max(0.0)`. This threshold controls when poor condition starts contributing to the molt stress index but cannot be tuned through species data. Similarly, the thermal stress clamp max of 0.5 on line 492 is hardcoded. Both should be named parameters.
